description: Search open cybersecurity roles (SOC and incident response, security engineering, cloud security, application security, identity and access, penetration testing and red team, threat intelligence, GRC and compliance, security architecture and consulting and security leadership) read from the hiring systems of 744 employers. Returns each role's title, employer, specialty, stated salary, where it hires and a link to the role. Every filter is optional.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'DE'): only roles that accept applicants in that country.

kind.description: Security specialty, one of the listed slugs, e.g. 'security-operations', 'cloud-security', 'governance-risk-compliance'.

limit.description: Number of roles to return (1 to 25).

min_salary_usd.description: Only roles whose stated yearly salary reaches at least this many US dollars.

query.description: Words matched against role titles, e.g. 'SOC analyst', 'Okta', 'penetration tester', 'FedRAMP'.

name: search_cybersecurity_jobs
title: Search cybersecurity jobs
